summary: Corteva and EIDP filed an 8-K disclosing EIDP's $700 million private placement of 6.000% senior notes due August 15, 2036, with interest payable semi-annually beginning February 15, 2027. The debt raise supports the previously announced separation into two public companies: crop protection (EIDP) and seed (Vylor Inc.). Notes were sold under Rule 144A and Regulation S, unregistered. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes, including commercial paper repayment. The structural clock now turns on SEC Form 10 effectiveness, financing conditions, and board final approval; watch for ratio, tax-free treatment, and debt allocation risks.
